what_this_is: Session 150's own placement of the 28 materials chosen in experiments 28 and 34 against one human teaching canon: the base `datasets` package of R, index page https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/datasets/html/00Index.html (fetched 2026-10-22, sha256 a8ec8073c2cfb387a30010da2648655882cc75394a125b6bae165a79628ce220). Coded by the practice alone, not blind, after reading both works' results. SAME = the same series from the same keeper; KIN = the same phenomenon at the same place, another record; NONE = no entry of the index names it.
rule: Match on the dataset's phenomenon and place as the index entry's title states it. Nothing is matched on method or on discipline.

r01: co2: Mauna Loa Atmospheric CO2 Concentration
r08: faithful: Old Faithful Geyser Data; another record of the same geyser

r10: LakeHuron: Level of Lake Huron 1875-1972; Michigan-Huron is one water body, another record
r04: not in the base package; the base package has lung-disease deaths, not measles
